I have resolved the issue where proxy authentication failed with a 407 status code.

### Cause
In [`requests/utils.py`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py), [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960-L987) uses `urllib3.util.parse_url` to parse proxy URLs. Unlike the standard library's `urllib.parse.urlparse`, `urllib3.util.parse_url` does not include `auth` within `parsed.netloc`. When reconstructing the URL with `urlunparse`, the proxy credentials (`user:password@`) were dropped from `netloc`, omitting the `Proxy-Authorization` header and resulting in an HTTP 407 error.

### Solution
Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py#L960-L987) in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///testbed/requests/utils.py) to re-attach `auth` to `netloc` when present (`netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])`) before reconstructing the URL with `urlunparse`.
